text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu was showered with applause 
from the spectators. Feeling her love for 
racing as a whole deepen once more, she 
wished to run on an even greater stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer harbors the same wish: to see 
more of her races in the future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both shared the same desire to pursue an 
even greater run. Thus, the Trainer took 
the initiative to handle interviews in 
place of Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because they shared the same feelings, she 
could answer in her stead— Mejiro Ramonu 
did not deny that explanation.
